title: Vending Machine
summary: Select items, pay with coins and notes, get change, handle stock.
description: Design a vending machine that sells snacks and drinks. A customer selects an item, inserts coins or notes, and receives the item plus change. An operator restocks the machine and collects cash.

requirements.text: The customer selects an item by its slot code and sees its price.
The machine accepts coins and notes of fixed denominations and tracks the amount inserted.
When enough money is inserted, the item is dispensed and change is returned.
An out-of-stock item cannot be bought, and the customer is told so before paying.
The customer can cancel at any point before dispensing and gets a full refund.
An admin can restock items and collect cash.

constraints: The machine may be unable to make exact change; it must not take money it can't return.
Only one customer uses the machine at a time.
Hardware (coin slot, motor) is behind interfaces; don't model electronics.

changeRequest.title: UPI and card payments
changeRequest.text: Accept UPI and card payments alongside cash. Digital payments are confirmed asynchronously by a payment provider and need no change.
